subject: Marketplace metering ledger sweep & VAT reallocation for Q2 usage
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stellarcloud.io>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected VAT on June marketplace invoice

Hi Tessa,

We just received our aggregated AWS Marketplace invoice for June and noticed VAT applied to a subset of usage lines that previously were zero-rated for us. The invoice shows a "marketplace fee" line with VAT at 20% and the net amount looks like it was attributed to Redwood EU entity (FR). That doesn't match our contract (we're an Irish entity, reverse charge should apply).

Summary:
- Invoice ID: STCL-INV-202806-4553 (PDF attached)
- Affected SKUs: marketplace:ai-inference-prod (approx 18% of June usage)
- VAT posted: €12,340.00

Can you trace which ledger/entity these lines were routed to and whether this came from a SKU mapping change on your side or an AWS metering reclassification? We need an updated invoice or credit note before our finance run on Monday.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Cloud Ops, Stellar Cloud
liam.oconnor@stellarcloud.io
attachment: invoice-preview-202806.pdf (PDF, 245KB)
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2028 16:40:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Unexpected VAT on June marketplace invoice — quick ledger trace pls

Team — forwarding a customer escalation. TL;DR: Stellar Cloud sees VAT posted to our FR entity; customer insists the reverse-charge should apply (IE entity). This looks like a cross-entity meter attribution issue that surfaced after the SKU consolidation we rolled out May 28.

Actions I need:
- Sean: can you run a ledger sweep for June usage for account STCL and produce a breakdown by internal entity (US/EU/FR/IE) and by SKU? I attached the quick csv I started (tessa_ledger_analysis_202806.csv).
- Marissa: if this is an attribution error we may need to issue credit memos and coordinate tax reclaim — can you prep the credit memo template and a draft note to Stellar Finance?

Also: include any HubSpot deal id or billing tags in the sweep output (link to deal included). Customer is awaiting before Monday close.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
attachment: tessa_ledger_analysis_202806.csv (CSV, 18KB)
From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unexpected VAT on June marketplace invoice — quick ledger trace pls

Tessa — digging in. Early findings:
- We have a SKU mapping change on 2028-05-28 where three legacy SKUs were consolidated into "marketplace:ai-inference-prod". The mapping table used for invoicing still contains a residual entity ID that points to our FR listing for certain usage fingerprints. I've attached the raw metering extract I pulled from our billing jobs (aws_marketplace_skushift_202806.csv).
- Affected usage window: 2028-06-01 -> 2028-06-20 (~63% of the customer's June volume).
- Estimated VAT mis-post: €11,920. I'm still reconciling token-level attribution to confirm the exact net.

Proposal for next steps:
1) Create a temporary ledger sweep to re-attribute the affected consumption lines from Redwood FR -> Redwood IE (reverse-charge) for that customer's account. This will produce a credit on the FR entity and a corresponding rebook on the IE ledger.
2) Prepare credit memos for Stellar Cloud and cover AWS Marketplace fee timing differences (we may need a small rounding adjustment).
3) Open an expedited case with AWS Marketplace billing to confirm there is no downstream metering reclassification on their side. Do not wait on their timeline for issuing customer credits; we should provision credits and then reconcile if AWS confirms otherwise.

I will produce the ledger CSV and a proposed journal entry list by end of day.

Sean Gallagher
Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
attachment: aws_marketplace_skushift_202806.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 10:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unexpected VAT on June marketplace invoice — quick ledger trace pls

Thanks Sean — that's consistent with what my team flagged in our monthly VAT sampling. If we go ahead with the sweep, here's what the billing ops team needs from product & legal before we issue credits:
- Confirmation of the corrective entity mapping for the affected SKUs (signed off by Product).
- Tax evidence for Stellar Cloud (VAT registration and place-of-supply justification). Liam, please send your Irish VAT registration docs; you mentioned an EU tax team earlier.
- A draft credit memo and customer-facing note. I'm attaching the credit-memo-template we'll use.

I agree with provisioning credits (manual memo) immediately and mark them as "subject to reconciliation with AWS case #". We should also capture the journal adjustments for internal P&L.

I'll draft the memo and a customer note once Sean provides the per-line re-attribution export.

Marissa Cole
Billing & Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
attachment: credit-memo-template.docx (DOCX, 28KB)
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stellarcloud.io>, aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2028 14:10:00 +0000
Subject: Proposed settlement plan — Stellar Cloud (STCL) June VAT mis-post

Hi Liam / AWS Support,

Thanks for raising this. Summary of our internal findings:
- Root cause: SKU consolidation on our side led to residual entity attribution for a subset of metering fingerprints; this caused ~€11.9k VAT to be posted to Redwood FR rather than reverse-charged to Stellar IE.
- Scope: ~63% of Stellar's June usage (see attached CSV).

Proposed resolution timeline and actions:
1) Immediate: Redwood will issue provisional credit memos to Stellar (FR entity) for the VAT amount and rebook the consumption to the IE ledger so Stellar's payments are unaffected by the VAT posting. Credit memos will be marked "provisional — pending AWS confirmation". (Action: Marissa)
2) Parallel: Redwood opens case with AWS Marketplace to confirm there was no downstream metering reclassification. (Action: Tessa — case submitted below)
3) Within 7 business days: If AWS confirms a rerecording at their end, Redwood will finalize journals and issue final credit note; if AWS disputes, we'll reconcile the difference between our provisional credit and AWS outcome.

Deliverables attached: ledger attribution CSV, draft customer-facing credit memo, and VAT evidence request. Liam — please share your Irish VAT registration and a contact at Stellar TaxOps so we can include them on the final documentation.

Case submitted to AWS: AWS-MKT-BILL-129874 (pending). DocuSign link for final credit acceptance (placeholder): https://docusign.com/link/placeholder

Apologies for the disruption — we want to make this as frictionless as possible.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
attachments: tessa_ledger_analysis_202806.csv, aws_marketplace_skushift_202806.csv, vat_evidence_france_q2.pdf

Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposed settlement plan — Stellar Cloud (STCL) June VAT mis-post — Case AWS-MKT-BILL-129874

Hello Tessa and Liam,

Thanks for the detailed submission and the attached billing extracts. We've opened an internal metering review for case AWS-MKT-BILL-129874. Initial findings:
- There was an entity attribution mismatch at the marketplace listing level after the 28-May SKU consolidation. Our team can corroborate the reclassification on our end for a subset of the fingerprints; we are targeting a full run and confirmation within 5 business days.
- Please supply customer VAT evidence for Stellar (Irish VAT reg.) to speed the tax reallocation — we will need this for our records to issue any marketplace-level corrections.

Next steps (AWS):
1) AWS will confirm whether the metering reclassification propagated to downstream invoice generation and provide the list of affected invoice lineIDs.
2) AWS will advise whether they can issue a marketplace-level correction/credit or whether the vendor (Redwood) must issue credits and submit evidence for AWS to accept the correction.

We will update case AWS-MKT-BILL-129874 within 5 business days. If you have interim accounting actions (credit memos), please include "subject to AWS confirmation" language.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Billing Team
aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com
